ref.description: One object ref returned by docx_list_objects or docx_find_literal. Read a selected table or row to inspect grid spans and merges without listing all cells.

revision.description: Optional expected revision id from the observation receipt; a changed document fails as stale.

kinds.description: Object kinds required by the next operation. Both the response and artifact contain only matching descendant identities.

output.description: Absolute path for a new JSON artifact containing the selected native object and only the requested descendant kinds.
